reviews.comment: Miss. Renwick is a great professor and really helpful. She responds to emails quickly, and takes the time to explain concepts or work with you to practice communication skills.

This was for Comm 210. I can't fathom why Professor Renwick has low ratings on Rate My Professor, she's been nothing but wonderful. She is kind, clear, and always explains expectations well. Attend class, ask questions, and seek feedback if needed and you'll succeed. I genuinely loved her teaching and wish I could take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Genuinely awful. Super strict rubrics, overly complicated guidelines, and zero clarity on any of this. You learn nothing helpful about debate, and the in class ones were a mess because no one understood what to do. It's not even that it's difficult, she was just very unclear on how/what we should be doing. Take any other comm class.

I didn't take 203, I took 243, but either way I would skip her courses. She's very easy to get along with, but way overcomplicates the course. The debates require outlines that are hyperspecific, and she doesn't clearly explain how to do it. The debates were honestly a waste of time because no one was prepared. Find another comm class if you can.

I took Dr. Renwick for my second summer semester of 2023 and she was very lenient. I turned in my first speech a day late and she was extremely understanding giving me full credit. She around 100 points extra credit at the end of the class for those who were more participating. She sometimes takes a while to respond but overall great professor.
